newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Telmex offers 19 pct pay hike - union.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Telmex offers 19 pct pay hike - union.

text.p: Mexican telephone giant Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) offered Tuesday a 19 percent pay increase, plus 4 percent in benefits, the Mexican Telephone Workers' Union said.
The main telephone workers' union had demanded Monday a rise of 47.43 percent in the annual round of pay talks.
In a statement, the union said Telmex and the Labor Ministry presented the offer in the early hours of Tuesday morning saying it was the "final and definitive proposal".
Union leaders decided unanimously to accept the proposal and agreed to ask rank-and-file members to consider it.
"It will be put to the telephone workers, who in an individual, direct and secret vote, will decide whether to accept or reject it," the union said.

Union members will decide on the package over Tuesday and Wednesday and if approved union leaders will formally sign the annual pay revision on Wednesday afternoon. "If the answer is negative, a strike will be called from April 25 at 12 noon (local time)," the union statement said.
